# Rupert

Rupert is an expert-led investor outreach service designed for founders raising capital. Rather than relying on automated campaigns or generic investor lists, every outreach effort is researched, written, and managed with precision to reach investors who actively back companies like yours.

Throughout the process, you have complete transparency into every email, every conversation, and every response. Rupert never owns your relationships or takes a percentage of your raise. You keep every investor connection, while benefiting from the discipline, experience, and craftsmanship of a professional fundraising operator.

## Articles

- [How to Find Investors for Your Startup: The Complete Guide](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/angel-investors/): Learn how to find angel investors, VCs, and micro-funds — with a qualified target list, warm intro tactics, and pipeline management for Seed founders.
- [Angel Investors vs. Venture Capital: What Fits Your Raise?](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/angel-investors-vs-venture-capital/): Angels and VCs differ on check size, stage fit, and governance. This guide helps founders decide which investor type fits their raise and when to target both.
- [How to Get Investors for Your Business: A Founder's Guide](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/how-to-get-investors-for-your-business/): Everything founders need to know to attract, approach, and close the right investors — from building your target list to running a disciplined process.
- [Get Investors for Your Business Idea: Readiness Checklist](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/how-to-get-investors-for-your-business-idea/): Wondering how to get investors for your business idea? This pre-traction checklist covers everything founders need before their first pitch.
- [How to Get Private Investors for Your Business: A Guide](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/how-to-get-private-investors-for-your-business/): A step-by-step guide for founders approaching angels, family offices, and high-net-worth backers — from defining your raise to closing the loop.
- [What Investors Looking for Projects to Fund Actually Want](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/investors-looking-for-projects-to-fund/): Discover what active investors evaluate before funding a project — team quality, market size, traction by stage, and deal terms that actually close.
- [Pitch Deck: A Founder's Complete Guide to Raising Capital](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/pitch-deck/): What every pitch deck must include, how structure changes from seed to Series A, and what turns a strong deck into investor meetings and term sheets.
- [Pre-Seed vs Seed Pitch Deck: What Changes Between Rounds](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/pre-seed-pitch-deck/): A practical guide to how pre-seed and seed pitch decks differ in structure, evidence, and investor expectations — so the right deck reaches the right people.
- [Seed Pitch Deck FAQ: Practical Questions, Honest Answers](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/seed-funding-pitch-deck-faq/): Fast answers to the questions founders ask most when finalizing a seed pitch deck: format, length, when to send it, and what investors actually read.
- [The Complete Seed Pitch Deck Guide for Raising Founders](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/seed-pitch-deck/): Learn what goes in a seed pitch deck, which slides drive investor decisions, and how to build one that gets meetings in a competitive funding market.
- [Seed Pitch Deck Examples: 7 Real Decks — and What Worked](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/seed-pitch-deck-examples/): Seven real seed pitch decks that raised funding — what each one got right, why investors said yes, and the structural lessons you can apply to your own raise.
- [Seed Round Pitch Deck: Structure All 12 Slides Step-by-Step](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/seed-round-pitch-deck-template/): A slide-by-slide framework for your seed pitch deck — what each of the 12 slides must prove, in what order, and how to close with a clear, specific ask.
